notes: litert-community/LFM3-1.7B-LiteRT: LFM3-1.7B_mixed_int4_ekv4096.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM generic_model conversion of LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B at revision 40ebe0aa (LFM Open License v1.0): a hybrid decoder (13 short-convolution, 6 global-attention and 5 sliding-window layers), text in, text out; it thinks in a <think> block by default (enable_thinking switches it off); tool calls come back as XML text (no LiteRT-LM parser reads them). One conversation per Engine (a new conversation on a used Engine continues from the last one's convolution state). Pixel 8a (phone 4C131JEKB15210) rows: holds p3, p4 of run r8 on 2026-10-29 JST, reboot none (uptime per run). The benchmark = two processes of the published file in one hold; the 8 questions = one process each. Landed 2026-10-29: litert-community/LFM3-1.7B-LiteRT is public, upload commit 9bbda264c6 (2026-10-29T04:51:50+00:00), main 9bbda264c6 at the read; the tree's LFS oid and size of LFM3-1.7B_mixed_int4_ekv4096.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 1441629120 B (anonymous, read 2026-10-29T14:06:54+09:00).
quantization: MLP gate and up projections (w1 / w3) int4 blockwise-32 (min-max, block scales floored at 2^-14); every other fully connected weight, the tied lm_head and the embedding table int8 channelwise (dynamic_wi8_afp32: the CPU quantizes activations to int8 at run time); no activation type declared (the GPU runs float16 activations by default); sampler TOP_P k 50 / p 1 / temperature 0.1; KV cache 4,096 tokens
